status: DRAFT saved-target schema. Not accepted directly by current engine/API; future acquisition/persistence adapter required.
notes: Choose once at talent unlock or relic acquisition; save only after confirmation. Cancel leaves the existing state unchanged.
A card binding follows the owned instance when it moves; an unavailable card stays inactive, without automatic replacement.
A slot binding retains its zero-based coordinate and affects eligible future occupants; these examples explicitly use occupied-cell matching.
Retargeting is an explicit later player action when allowed; do not ask again before each battle or reset consumed uses.
The future adapter validates ownership/source versions, remaps owned card references to battle pieceRefs, and builds existing preBattle sources/bindings plus trusted heroPieceRefs.
Automatic sources need no saved target selection. Presentation IDs and chosenAt are not engine recipe fields.
Draft picker policy: choose any valid board slot, including an empty slot or one whose current card is ineligible; effect eligibility is checked when the battle is prepared.
